about.titleAccent: students, by people who understand the system
about.p1: ReadAM started with a simple observation: Cameroonian students are hardworking, talented, and ambitious — but they often lack access to structured study tools that align with their actual exams. We built ReadAM to close that gap.
about.p2: From AI-powered tutoring and a curated PDF library to real GCE past questions and video lessons — everything on ReadAM is designed around the GCE Ordinary & Advanced Level and Baccalauréat syllabi.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every decision we make.
about.v1d: Every piece of content — AI answers, PDFs, video courses — is mapped to the Cameroonian GCE and Baccalauréat syllabi. No irrelevant material.
about.v2d: We design features by asking students what they struggle with most. Study plans, streak reminders, and bilingual explanations all came from student feedback.
about.v3d: Cameroon has two official languages. ReadAM respects that — every core feature works in both English and French, and you can switch instantly.
about.v4d: Powerful AI tutoring shouldn't be reserved for students in expensive private schools. ReadAM makes it accessible to every student, anywhere in Cameroon.
about.teamSubtitle: Educators and technologists who believe in Cameroonian students.
about.role1bio: 10+ years designing exam prep materials for GCE and Bac students.
about.role2bio: Physics & Mathematics specialist with 8 years in secondary education.
about.role3bio: Combines cognitive science research with AI to make learning stick.
about.ctaTitle: Join thousands of students already winning with ReadAM
about.ctaBody: Start free today — no credit card required.

featuresPage.intro: ReadAM is built from the ground up for Cameroonian students — combining AI-powered tutoring, a curated course library, and gamified progress tracking into one platform.
featuresPage.f1d: Ask anything, get step-by-step explanations in English or French. The AI Tutor adapts to your level and builds personalised study plans around your weak areas.
featuresPage.f2d: Thousands of curriculum-aligned notes from top schools across Cameroon. Download and study offline anytime.
featuresPage.f3d: Practice with 5 years of real GCE and Baccalauréat exam papers.
featuresPage.f4d: High-quality lessons from the most requested tutors in Cameroon, on demand.
featuresPage.f5d: Visualise your mastery per subject with XP points, daily streaks, and weekly charts.
featuresPage.m1d: Download notes and past questions and study even without an internet connection.
featuresPage.m2d: Switch interface language instantly. Content is available in both official languages of Cameroon.
featuresPage.m3d: Earn badges, maintain streaks, and climb leaderboards to stay motivated throughout your studies.
featuresPage.m4d: Browse verified tutors, view their ratings, and enrol in their courses directly.
featuresPage.m5d: Get reminders for assignments, streak alerts, AI study suggestions, and payment receipts.
featuresPage.m6d: Separate, secure portals for students, tutors, and admins — each with tailored tools.

terms.intro: These terms govern your use of ReadAM. By creating an account you agree to them, so please read them before you sign up.
terms.draftBody: This document describes how ReadAM actually operates and is a working draft. It has not yet been reviewed by a qualified lawyer admitted in Cameroon. Have it reviewed before you rely on it commercially.
terms.p1a: ReadAM is an online learning platform for students in Cameroon, offering courses, past questions and an AI study tutor mapped to the GCE and Baccalauréat syllabi. In these terms, “we”, “us” and “ReadAM” mean the operator of this platform, and “you” means the person using it.
terms.p2a: You need an account to access most of ReadAM. You agree to give accurate information, keep your password confidential, and tell us promptly if you believe someone else has accessed your account.
terms.p2b: Accounts are personal. Sharing your login so that others can use content you paid for is a breach of these terms and may result in suspension.
terms.p2c: If you are under 18, you may use ReadAM with the knowledge of a parent or guardian, who accepts these terms on your behalf.
terms.p3a: All prices are shown in Central African Francs (XAF) and include any taxes we are required to collect. Payments are taken by mobile money through our payment provider, MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money, and you authorise each payment on your own handset.
terms.p3b: A payment is only complete once our payment provider confirms it. Until then the transaction shows as pending. If you are debited but your access does not open within 24 hours, contact us at <mail></mail> with your transaction reference and we will resolve it.
terms.p3c: We never ask for your mobile money PIN. Anyone who does is not acting for ReadAM.
terms.p4a: AI tutoring is sold as session credits. A credit is consumed when a session starts, and each session runs for a fixed period shown in the app before it expires. Unused credits remain on your account until their stated expiry date.
terms.p4b: The AI tutor is a study aid, not a substitute for your teacher or your own work. It can be wrong. Always verify important facts before relying on them in an examination or assessment. We are not responsible for examination outcomes.
terms.p4c: Do not use the AI tutor to produce work you will present as your own where your school prohibits it. Academic-honesty rules are set by your institution, not by us.
terms.p5a: Because course content and AI credits are delivered immediately, purchases are generally final. We will, however, refund you where:
terms.l5a: you were charged more than once for the same purchase;
terms.l5b: you were debited but access never opened and we cannot fix it;
terms.l5c: the content you bought is materially not as described.
terms.p5b: Request a refund within 14 days of the charge by emailing us with your transaction reference. Approved refunds are returned to the mobile money account used to pay.
terms.p6a: Tutors publish courses on ReadAM and keep ownership of the material they upload. By publishing, a tutor grants us a licence to host, display and distribute that material to students on the platform.
terms.p6b: Tutors must have the right to everything they upload. Uploading material that infringes someone else's copyright will result in its removal and may end the tutor's account.
terms.p6c: Courses are reviewed before publication, but review is not a guarantee of accuracy. Tutor earnings, the platform fee and payout timing are set out in the tutor dashboard.
terms.p8a: We work to keep ReadAM available, but we do not promise uninterrupted service. We may suspend access for maintenance, and we may change or withdraw features. Where a change materially reduces something you have paid for, we will offer a pro-rata refund.
terms.p9a: Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Subject to that, our total liability to you in connection with ReadAM is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including examination results.
terms.p10a: You may stop using ReadAM at any time and ask us to delete your account. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. We may suspend or end access if you materially breach these terms, and we will tell you why unless we are legally prevented from doing so.
terms.p11a: We may update these terms. If a change is material we will notify you in the app or by email before it takes effect. Continuing to use ReadAM after that means you accept the updated terms.
terms.p11b: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Cameroon, and the courts of Cameroon have jurisdiction over any dispute.
terms.p12a: Questions about these terms? Email <mail></mail> or visit our <contact>contact page</contact>.

privacy.intro: What we collect, why we collect it, and what you can do about it. We have written this in plain language rather than legal boilerplate.
privacy.draftBody: This policy describes ReadAM's actual data practices and is a working draft. It has not been reviewed by a qualified data-protection lawyer. Confirm it against Cameroon's Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection before relying on it.
privacy.c1: your name, email address, and optionally a phone number and profile photo.
privacy.c2: courses you enrol in, lessons you complete, your position in a video, XP, streaks and badges.
privacy.c3: the messages you send and receive, and any file you attach to a session.
privacy.c4pre: amount, currency, status, product and the mobile money network used. We do
privacy.c4post: receive or store your mobile money PIN, and we do not store full payment credentials.
privacy.c5: the subjects and goals you select, used to recommend courses.
privacy.c6: the information your browser sends with each request, such as device type and approximate location, used for security and to diagnose faults.
privacy.p2a: We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use your AI conversations to advertise to you.
privacy.p3a: When you use the AI tutor, your message and any attachment are sent to a third-party AI model provider to generate a response. Do not paste anything into the tutor you would not want processed by a third party, including identity documents, passwords or someone else's personal information.
privacy.p3b: Your conversations are stored against your account so you can resume a session and review past summaries. You can ask us to delete them.
privacy.p4a: We may also disclose data where the law requires it. If ReadAM is ever sold or merged, we will tell you before your data moves to a new controller.
privacy.p5a: ReadAM runs on cloud infrastructure that may process and store data outside Cameroon. Where data leaves the country we rely on our providers' contractual safeguards to keep it protected to the standard described here.
privacy.k2: while your account is open, or until you delete them.
privacy.k3: retained after account closure where accounting law requires it.
privacy.k4: a short rolling window for security and diagnostics.
privacy.r1: show you the personal data we hold about you;
privacy.r2: correct anything inaccurate (you can edit most of it yourself in Settings);
privacy.r3: delete your account and associated data;
privacy.r4: export your data in a portable format;
privacy.p7a: Email <mail></mail> and we will respond within 30 days. You can also complain to Cameroon's data protection authority.
privacy.p8a: Access to the platform requires authentication, traffic is encrypted in transit, and uploaded files are stored in access-controlled cloud storage. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password and tell us immediately if you think your account has been accessed by someone else.
privacy.p9a: We store a small amount of data in your browser to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. These are strictly necessary for the platform to function. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Clearing your browser storage signs you out.
privacy.p10a: ReadAM is built for secondary school students, and many are under 18. We collect the minimum needed to teach them. If you are a parent or guardian and want to review or delete your child's data, contact us and we will help.
privacy.p11a: If we make a material change to this policy we will tell you in the app or by email before it takes effect.
privacy.p11b: Questions? Email <mail></mail> or see our <terms>Terms of Use</terms>.
